generators.description: General location picker. A location sets place state; indoor/outdoor compatibility belongs on room/area values.
Room or area picker. Values validate against environment.domain and either a compatible environment.location or missing environment.location.
Person-contact surface picker. Values validate against environment.room_area. Phrase assembly belongs to the environment.surface builder.
Surface relation picker. Values avoid pose/action wording. Slot existence validation belongs to the builder slot definition.
Sparse environment condition picker. Use only for meaningful setting states and validate individual values where needed.
Neutral season picker. Builder exports the selected value into environment.season for weather compatibility.
Outdoor weather picker. Values are season-aware where needed; builder exports the selected value into environment.weather.
Neutral daypart/time picker. Builder exports the selected value into environment.time; detailed lighting remains in Lighting.
Sparse social context picker for public/private, crowded/empty, or similar scene occupancy cues.
Sparse environment props picker. Values should add useful set context around the person rather than clutter.
